title: rosa canina var. trachyphylla
intro: Rosa canina var. trachyphylla, commonly known as the dwarf or alpine rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant. It is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, known for its fragrant flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. trachyphylla include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, skin conditions, and as a diuretic, due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
